<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Milestone" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdateMaterials" name="Material list update requested"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Bragging to friends"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsSent" name="Materials sent to friends"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Player" name="Player" processRef="Process_Player"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_MaterialsSent"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Player" name="Farming Bot Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BotRequested" name="Farming bot requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_ApplyToolDependencies" name="Apply tool dependency rules">
      <bpmn:documentation>Resources required to create tools are added according to the custom game dependency logic.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmStart_Merge" name="Start or resume farming"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Farming started"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResource" name="Farm resource">
        <bpmn:documentation>Up to 10 resources are collected in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
          <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">10</bpmn:loopCardinality>
        </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FarmingDone" name="Farming finished"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_FarmResource"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmDone" sourceRef="Task_FarmResource" targetRef="EndEvent_FarmingDone"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster" attachedToRef="SubProcess_Farming" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisasterSetback" name="Apply disaster setback"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="SubProcess_Farming" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notified"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_UpdateMaterials" name="Material list update requested" attachedToRef="SubProcess_Farming" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_UpdateMaterials" messageRef="Message_UpdateMaterials"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MaterialsUpdated" name="Materials list updated"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectSharing" name="Select friends and materials to share"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Share options"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BotCompleted" name="Bot cycle completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_BotRequested" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ApplyToolDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ApplyToolDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_FarmStart_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmStart_Merge" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_SelectSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_DisasterSetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_DisasterSetback" targetRef="Gateway_FarmStart_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="EndEvent_MaterialsUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SelectSharing" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${materialsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_BotCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/farming-bot">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FindResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MaterialsUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_BotCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyToolDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Farm_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisasterSetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_UpdateMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BotFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BotRequested" name="Farming bot requested"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_FindResources" name="Find out which resources you want">
      <bpmn:documentation>Some resources are more urgently needed than others. Up to 10 resources can be collected in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestoneNotReached" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestone" targetRef="Gateway_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Gateway_Farm_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_BotFinished" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${botFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotFinished" sourceRef="Gateway_BotFinished" targetRef="Gateway_Farm_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_DisasterSetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_DisasterSetback" targetRef="Gateway_Farm_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="EndEvent_MaterialsUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${materialsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyToolDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisasterSetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BotFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BotRequested" name="Farming bot requested"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_FindResources" name="Find out which resources you want"/>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_ApplyToolDependencies" name="Apply tool dependency rules">
      <bpmn:documentation>Resources required to create tools are added according to the custom game dependency logic.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Up to 10 resources are collected in parallel; urgently needed resources are prioritized.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisasterSetback" name="Apply disaster setback"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_UpdateMaterials" name="Material list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_UpdateMaterials" messageRef="Message_UpdateMaterials"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MaterialsUpdated" name="Materials list updated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Milestone" name="Milestone reached?" default="Flow_MilestoneNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BotFinished" name="Bot finished?" default="Flow_NotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Brag and/or send materials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BotCompleted" name="Bot cycle completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_BotRequested" targetRef="Task_FindResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_FindResources" targetRef="Task_ApplyToolDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ApplyToolDependencies" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${milestoneReached}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestoneNotReached" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestone" targetRef="Gateway_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_BotFinished" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${botFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotFinished" sourceRef="Gateway_BotFinished" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_DisasterSetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_DisasterSetback" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="EndEvent_MaterialsUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${materialsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_BotCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
